disclaimer: Practice questions for self-assessment and daily study warm-up. Not official past examination papers.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: Force = mass × acceleration (kg·m/s²), defined as 1 Newton (N) in the SI system.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Two resistors of 6 Ω and 3 Ω are connected in parallel. What is their equivalent resistance?
questions.explanation: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/3 = 3/6 = 1/2, so equivalent resistance R = 2 Ω.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Which phenomenon explains the sparkling of a diamond?
questions.explanation: Diamond has a high refractive index (~2.42) and a small critical angle (~24.4°), causing repeated Total Internal Reflection.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: In the photoelectric effect, the maximum kinetic energy of emitted photoelectrons depends directly on:
questions.explanation: By Einstein's photoelectric equation K_max = hν − φ₀, maximum kinetic energy depends on frequency ν (above threshold) and work function φ₀.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: What is the pH of pure neutral water at 25°C?
questions.explanation: At 25°C, [H⁺] = 10⁻⁷ mol/L in pure water, giving pH = −log₁₀(10⁻⁷) = 7.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: What is the hybridization of the carbon atom in methane (CH₄)?
questions.explanation: Carbon in CH₄ forms four sigma bonds in a tetrahedral geometry (109.5°), corresponding to sp³ hybridization.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which element has the highest electronegativity on the Pauling scale?
questions.explanation: Fluorine (Pauling electronegativity ≈ 3.98) is the most electronegative element.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: For a process to be spontaneous at constant temperature and pressure, the Gibbs free energy change (ΔG) must be:
questions.explanation: A reaction or process at constant T and P is thermodynamically spontaneous when ΔG = ΔH − TΔS < 0.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which organelle is primarily responsible for ATP synthesis through aerobic respiration?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria carry out the Krebs cycle and oxidative phosphorylation to generate most cellular ATP.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which blood vessel carries oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium of the heart?
questions.explanation: The pulmonary veins transport oxygen-rich blood from the lungs into the left atrium.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: In DNA double helix structure, Adenine (A) pairs specifically with Thymine (T) via:
questions.explanation: A–T base pairs are stabilized by 2 hydrogen bonds, while G–C pairs are stabilized by 3 hydrogen bonds.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which enzyme catalyzes the primary CO₂ fixation step in the Calvin cycle (C₃ pathway)?
questions.explanation: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase-oxygenase (RuBisCO) fixes CO₂ onto RuBP in the Calvin cycle.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: What is the derivative of sin(x) with respect to x?
questions.explanation: d/dx [sin(x)] = cos(x).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If the roots of x² − 7x + 12 = 0 are α and β, what is the value of α + β?
questions.explanation: By Vieta's formulas for ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots α + β = −b/a = 7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: What is the exact value of sin²(30°) + cos²(30°)?
questions.explanation: For any angle θ, the Pythagorean identity states sin²(θ) + cos²(θ) = 1.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: When two fair six-sided dice are rolled simultaneously, what is the probability of getting a sum of 7?
questions.explanation: There are 6 favorable outcomes {(1,6),(2,5),(3,4),(4,3),(5,2),(6,1)} out of 36 total outcomes: 6/36 = 1/6.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the Right to Equality before Law?
questions.explanation: Article 14 guarantees equality before the law and equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.q: Indian Standard Time (IST) is ahead of Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) by:
questions.explanation: IST corresponds to 82.5° East longitude (passing near Mirzapur, UP), which is UTC+05:30.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.q: The Constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on:
questions.explanation: The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on 26 November 1949; it came into effect on 26 January 1950.

questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.q: Find the next number in the sequence: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step (+4, +6, +8, +10, +12), or n(n+1): 6 × 7 = 42.
